roadmap_items.text: Freeze the kernel before evaluating untouched cases.

roadmap_items.text: Audit the proposed twelve evaluation candidates for prior design use; replace contaminated cases where necessary.

roadmap_items.text: Evaluate across the planned execution environments.
roadmap_items.remaining_scope: Planned environment executions require exact environment/tool/state access; missing services/data may block only dependent evaluations.

roadmap_items.text: Report schema coverage, behavioral coverage, library reuse, new kernel concepts, external assumptions, and verification effort separately.
roadmap_items.remaining_scope: Report schema coverage, behavior, reuse, new kernel concepts, assumptions and effort separately; no collapsed headline certification.

roadmap_items.text: Rewrite the paper around demonstrated results and their limits.
roadmap_items.remaining_scope: Bounded claim correction is not complete manuscript rewrite; final paper follows demonstrated results and explicit limits.

roadmap_items.text: Update the ontology visualization and repository graph after the schema stabilizes.
roadmap_items.remaining_scope: Historical atlas prototype is40/44 tasks; new operational schema refresh follows stable accepted schema and cannot reuse old claim strength silently.

roadmap_items.text: Improve malformed-input diagnostics, standalone schema constraints, and package directory inventory checks.
roadmap_items.remaining_scope: Existing gate failure37/37 and corpus validation partially overlap; new standalone schema/package directory inventory acceptance still needed.

roadmap_items.text: Add explicit current-module-exclusion and broader audit-root fixtures.
roadmap_items.remaining_scope: Add actual current-module-exclusion and broader root negative/positive controls; full current import inventory alone does not prove these.

roadmap_items.text: Add a general duplicate-capability-list theorem and an isolated vault-liquidity regression.
roadmap_items.remaining_scope: General duplicate-capability-list theorem and isolated vault-liquidity regression have no concrete unarchived plan found.

roadmap_items.text: Extend individual actor/effect/supply comparison mutations in the older contract wrapper.
roadmap_items.remaining_scope: Separate older contract actor/effect/supply comparator faults require named independent runtime oracles.

roadmap_items.text: Strengthen mutation projection guards for attributed declarations/macros/notation/deriving and add separated wrong-world oracles; current concrete Sprint 7 sources are accepted with these recorded limits.
